Course Title: Pre-Calculus and Differential Equations Fundamentals

This course is designed for students with a strong foundation in high school algebra, aiming to bridge the gap to differential equations. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and problem-solving exercises, students will develop essential skills in pre-calculus, including functions, limits, and calculus prerequisites such as derivatives and integrals. By the end of the course, students will have a solid understanding of mathematical modeling, linear algebra, and differential equations, preparing them for advanced calculus and applications in physics, engineering, and other fields. The course is expected to last approximately 12 weeks, with a target duration of 48 hours of instruction.

expanded_query: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to public health and epidemiology fundamentals, tailored for non-clinical professionals. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of health sciences and statistics. Students will develop skills in disease surveillance, outbreak investigation, and data analysis, as well as learn key concepts such as population health, health disparities, and disease prevention. The course covers topics including epidemiological study design, data collection methods, and statistical analysis, with a target duration of 6 weeks.

Prerequisites include basic computer skills and a fundamental understanding of business operations. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and hands-on exercises, students will gain the skills to create and implement a digital marketing plan, including social media advertising, content creation, and analytics, as well as develop a comprehensive social media strategy to enhance brand awareness, drive website traffic, and increase sales. This course is designed to be completed in approximately 6-8 weeks, with a total of 24-30 hours of instruction.
hallucinated_keyword_terms: website traffic;computer skills;digital marketing plan;business owners;small business;digital business;digital entrepreneurship;digital management;computer skills;website traffic;lectures;discussions;hands-on exercises;digital marketing plan

query: I am starting a company and need entrepreneurship and fundraising fundamentals
expanded_query: In this course, "Entrepreneurship and Fundraising Fundamentals," students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the essential skills and knowledge required to launch and sustain a successful startup. Prerequisites include a basic understanding of business principles and a willingness to learn. This course covers topics such as business model development, market analysis, financial planning, and fundraising strategies, including venture capital, angel investors, and crowdfunding. Upon completion, students will be able to create a solid business plan, secure funding, and navigate the entrepreneurial landscape with confidence. The target duration of this course is approximately 6 weeks.

Prerequisites include a strong foundation in finance, accounting, and mathematics, typically acquired through a bachelor's degree in a related field. expanded_query: In this course, students will explore the principles and practices of sustainability, environmental policy, and corporate responsibility, developing a comprehensive understanding of the complex relationships between business, society, and the environment. Prerequisites include a foundational understanding of business principles and environmental science. Through a combination of lectures, case studies, and group discussions, students will gain skills in environmental impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, and sustainable business strategy, as well as learn about key topics such as climate change mitigation, green supply chain management, and corporate social responsibility reporting. This course is designed to be completed in 6 weeks, providing students with a thorough understanding of the concepts and tools necessary to drive sustainable business practices.

query: I want to improve my English grammar and academic writing
expanded_query: In this intermediate-level course, students will develop and refine their English grammar skills, focusing on complex sentence structures, verb tenses, and nuanced use of modifiers. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and writing workshops, participants will also enhance their academic writing abilities, learning to craft clear, concise, and well-supported arguments and essays. Topics will include effective thesis statement development, paragraph organization, and citation styles, with an emphasis on applying these skills in a variety of academic contexts. This 12-week course is designed for students with a solid foundation in English grammar and writing, and is ideal for those seeking to improve their writing skills for academic or professional purposes.
